question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Tedious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tedious"** means something that is too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous. (उबाऊ)

 
 
• **Example: **The lecture was so **tedious** that many students started to fall asleep.
 
 
 
• **"Boring" **refers to something that is not interesting or exciting. (नीरस)
 
 
• **Example: **The movie was so **boring **that I couldn't watch it till the end.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'tedious'** is **'boring'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Working** (काम कर रहा): Engaged in a task or activity.

 
 
• **Example:** She is currently working on a new project.
 
 
 
• **Exciting** (रोमांचक): Causing great enthusiasm and eagerness.
 
 
• **Example:** The match was so exciting that the audience couldn't sit still.
 
 
 
• **Happening** (घटित): An event or occurrence.
 
 
• **Example:** There is a lot happening in the city this weekend.
